verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot supports natural-language prompts to refactor code, generate multi-file edits in Agent mode, and assign tasks via mobile, plus an official MCP server enabling agentic/NL integration—showing real agentic capability. However, this is layered on top of GitHub's core Git/PR platform which itself is not natural-language operable, and community evidence raises doubts about Copilot's reliability and no evidence of NL control over core repo/project management workflows beyond Copilot-specific features.
